subject: Price runbook & confirmation of econ buyer + finance approver
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@blueoakhc.com>, Avery Thompson <avery@blueoakhc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + pricing runbook (ask: econ buyer & finance approver)

Hi Jordan / Avery —

Great conversation today — thanks for walking through the integration surface and your latency targets. I wanted to pull together the pricing/volume items we discussed so we can route this to the right approvers at Blue Oak. Attaching a short Pricing Runbook and a starter MAP for your review.

Summary from today's call:
- Estimated daily traffic: 100k–150k user prompts (peaks during clinic hours)
- Typical prompt length: 25–40 tokens; generative responses average ~220 tokens
- Expected monthly token burn (1st 6 months): 250M–400M tokens/month (scale plan in MAP)
- Initial integration: hosted API with dedicated burst for scheduled peak loads

Open pricing asks for you: please confirm the following so I can produce a tailored quote: 
1) Who is the economic buyer for this feature set (name + title)?
2) Who needs to sign off on budget/PO (finance contact)?
3) Target $/1M tokens you want us to price towards (range is fine)

Suggested preliminary unit-econ we ran in the model: $950–$1,250 per 1M tokens at committed monthly volumes (250M+). That range assumes modest batching and our quantization profile Q5 across fleets. If finance needs a lower target, we can map a dedicated reserved capacity commit to get below $900/1M.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm econ buyer + finance contact in reply (1 line)
- We share a draft commitment band and visible tradeoffs (latency vs $/1M)
- Intro call with Blue Oak finance to walk the MAP and signature path (15–30m)

Attachments:
- redwood_pricing_runbook_v1.pdf (high-level bands + quantization options)
- mutual_action_plan_blueoak.xlsx (milestones & owners)

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@blueoakhc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Thompson <avery@blueoakhc.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + pricing runbook (ask: econ buyer & finance approver)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the runbook. A couple quick answers from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Emily Saunders, VP Product (emily.saunders@blueoakhc.com) — she owns product economics for clinical AI features.
- Finance approver / PO route: Carlos Mendoza, Director of Finance (carlos.mendoza@blueoakhc.com) — he handles vendor spend over $100k ARR.

Volume: the 250M–400M tokens/month band looks right for Q3 ramp if pilots go well. Long-term steady state (12–18 months) could be ~600M/mo, but that's conditional on adoption.

Target unit-econ: Emily would like something around $700–$850 per 1M tokens to make the build work in our current roadmap. Carlos will need to see committed bands + clear SLAs before approving anything near those numbers. Can you provide a short table that maps commit level -> $/1M -> expected p50 latency?

Happy to do a short intro to Emily + Carlos next week. How does Tue or Wed look for you?

—Jordan
Sr Product Manager, Blue Oak Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@blueoakhc.com>, Avery Thompson <avery@blueoakhc.com>, Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@blueoakhc.com>, Carlos Mendoza <carlos.mendoza@blueoakhc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + pricing runbook (ask: econ buyer & finance approver)

Thanks Jordan — perfect, appreciate the clarity. Looping in Rishi (my sales lead) and pasting a brief mapping below so Emily/Carlos have something to react to ahead of an intro.

High-level commit -> $/1M -> expected p50 latency (approx):
- Reserved Band A (commit 250M/mo): $980 per 1M tokens — p50 ~ 140ms
- Reserved Band B (commit 500M/mo): $820 per 1M tokens — p50 ~ 130ms
- Reserved Band C (commit 1B+/mo): $650 per 1M tokens — p50 ~ 110ms

Notes:
- Pricing above assumes standard quantization (Q5) and that Blue Oak will allow prefix caching for common clinic prompts. If you require no caching or strict on-device policy, prices increase ~10–18%.
- We can offer an accelerated reserved trial (90 days) with prorated credits if you need to validate adoption before a full-term commit.

Proposed next steps:
1) Intro call: Marissa + Rishi + Jordan + Emily + Carlos (20–30m) — propose Tue, Apr 27 at 10:00am PT or Wed, Apr 28 at 9:00am PT.
2) Rishi to send a concise commitment worksheet and a one-page SLA summary ahead of the call.
3) If finance wants lower $/1M, we can layout options (longer commit, higher latency allowance, or hybrid private deployment pricing).

Carlos / Emily — any preference on time? If you want a pre-read, the attached runbook has the commit bands and tradeoffs; the MAP has a tentative procurement path (PO -> legal review -> kickoff).

Best,
Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Looping Vivek in to make sure we have alignment on commercial flexibility before the intro with Emily/Carlos. Vivek — short ask below:

- Can we prepare a 1-page commit worksheet that shows the three bands (250M / 500M / 1B+) with explicit $/1M and an optional row for an accelerated trial credit? PDF + single slide.
- Can we also get a note on the minimum SLA fallback (p50 targets and uptime) tied to each band so finance has something to sign off on?

I can draft the HubSpot deal update and an initial DocuSign envelope if we get tentative greenlight after the intro.

Jordan / Emily / Carlos — thanks for the quick responses. Marissa will confirm the calendar slot once we hear back on availability.

—Rishi
